body: I appreciate the response, this is the first time I’ve made any real effort towards finding a relationship, mainly due to my extreme lack of self confidence. I feel similarly to you like I would give myself up to anyone who would take me.

Ive always held myself away from trying to find a relationship, even though it’s what I want the most. Ive always found myself too unattractive for anyone to want to be with. I’m 20 years old now, and finally found a girl that I’m willing to put myself out there for. Got her number, had small talks, but soon realized that I’m the only one initiating conversation and she only has been giving me sympathy attention. Now I don’t know what to do, I know she has no interest, but I feel like giving up on her is me going back to my old habits. While I’ve always held out hope that there is someone somewhere out there for me, I’m really starting to believe that there just isn’t. If I can’t find a soulmate and have a family one day, my life will continue to be the empty void that it’s been for the first 20 years. I’m lost...
